statement: Written prospective elliptic-cover derivation for selected C/F3: u=x/(x+1),v=y/(x+1)^3 gives v²=2u6+u2+1 and degree2 quotient X=2u2,Y=2v to E:Y²=X3+2X+1. Explicit odd-chart pullback and homogeneous Richelot point-image route are derived with base-divisor, infinity, inverse-Frobenius and candidate F3^6 square-root conditions. No native map test, Lean theorem, recovered scalar, total chain or computational advantage has yet been obtained.
